newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia mining industry revenue up in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia mining industry revenue up in 95/96.

text.p: Sales in the Australian mining industry rose six percent to A$30.73 billion in the 1995/96 financial year to June 30, according to statistics released by the Australian Bureau of Statistics on Monday.
The 1995/96 result compared to revenue of A$28.94 billion in the previous year, the bureau said.
"All industries except oil and gas recorded increases in turnover," it said. "Increased production and higher prices were the main reasons for the increased turnover."
Sales in the coal mining industry rose seven percent to A$9.99 billion while turnover in the gold mining industry rose 14 percent to A$4.76 billion.
The mineral sands mining industry showed the largest percentage increase, jumping 20 percent to A$758 million.
Production decreases in the Victorian oil and gas fields resulted in an overall decline in turnover for the oil and gas industry, which fell two percent to A$7.51 billion.
"The coal mining industry remained the largest contributor to total turnover for the mining industries, accounting for 33 percent," the bureau said.
Oil and gas contributed 24 percent to total turnover and gold ore mining contributed 15 percent.
